# ScribeCat 0.24.3

This release improves File Viewer folder cards and makes linked PDFs much more useful inside the writing workflow.

## Folder counts in File Viewer

Folder cards now show how many direct notes and subfolders they contain, next to the modified date. This makes it easier to scan a collection without opening every folder.

## Better PDF reader

The built-in PDF reader now supports:

- previous/next page navigation;
- jumping directly to a page number;
- copying the text from the current PDF page;
- keyboard page navigation in the full preview.

## PDFs attached to Markdown split view

A local PDF link opened from a Markdown note can now be moved into desktop split view.

- The PDF uses the same built-in reader as the normal PDF preview.
- It opens beside the Markdown note rather than as its own document tab.
- The PDF is linked to the Markdown tab: switch away and it hides; return to the tab and it comes back.
- Closing the owning Markdown tab also closes the attached PDF.
- The owning tab gets a small **PDF** badge so the attachment is visible without creating a second tab.
- The normal split divider and left/right swap control continue to work with the attached PDF.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Reidar96/scribecat/compare/v0.24.2...v0.24.3
